summary_line: Actions are inert and powerless; only the Divine Will grants their fruits.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: By the command of the Creator, the fruits of actions are obtained. How then can action be supreme? It is not. It is inert.

translations.author: Hindi Translation
translations.text: ईश्वर की आज्ञा से कर्मों के फल प्राप्त होते हैं। तब कर्म कैसे श्रेष्ठ हो सकता है? नहीं। यह जड़ है।

summary_line: Karmic results are temporary but their accumulated weight obstructs spiritual liberation.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: In the ocean of actions, the cause of downfall; the fruit is impermanent and obstructs spiritual progress.

translations.author: Hindi Translation

summary_line: Selfless action offered to God purifies the mind and leads to liberation.

translations.text: Work which is performed as an offering to the Lord, without any desire for its fruits, purifies the mind and leads to liberation.

summary_line: Contemplation is the highest spiritual practice, transcending ritual and chanting.

translations.text: Among the actions performed by the body, speech, and mind — worship, chanting, and contemplation — each is superior to the preceding one in ascending order.

summary_line: All creation and its forms are divine manifestations; worshipping them as God is true worship.

summary_line: Silent mental japa is the highest form of spiritual practice as it transcends external forms and arises from pure consciousness.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Praise is good, but louder japa is better; softer japa is better than loud japa; yet the best of all is mental japa, born of the mind.

translations.text: स्तुति अच्छी है, पर उच्चस्वर का जप बेहतर है; मंद स्वर का जप उच्चस्वर जप से बेहतर है; परंतु सबसे श्रेष्ठ वह मानसिक जप है जो मन से उत्पन्न होता है।

metadata.summary_line: True bliss lies beyond bondage and liberation, realized here and now by the enlightened soul.
metadata.sruti_smriti_echo: Nirvana Shatakam echo

summary_line: True spiritual practice is egoless self-inquiry, the highest form of austerity as taught by Ramana Maharshi.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Self-inquiry, devoid of the ego, is a great penance. Realize this truth spoken by Ramana.

translations.author: Hindi Translation
translations.text: अहंकाररहित आत्मविचार महान तपस्या है। इस सत्य को रमण द्वारा उच्चारित जानें।
